title: Mod API 1.2: possess / release_pawn, camera.follow, keyboard switch
intro: About 5 minutes. Set up first: play as the Arisen (no pawn taken over, no co-op), outdoors with at least two pawns in the party, no enemies around. Most steps run by themselves; two ask you to press F6. Press End to start.

steps.text: A mod asks DPC to play the main pawn (slot 0). The usual transition should play, then you control the main pawn.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac1 then G_ac1 = true
local ok, why = _G.DPC_API.possess(0, { mod = 'api-control-1' })
G_res = tostring(ok) .. ' ' .. tostring(why or '')
end

steps.text: Now by character: the second pawn in the party list. Same transition, you control that pawn.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac2 then G_ac2 = true
local ok, why = (function() local p = _G.DPC_API.party(); local e = p[2]; if not e then return nil, 'only one pawn' end; return _G.DPC_API.possess(e.chara, { mod = 'api-control-1' }) end)()
G_res = tostring(ok) .. ' ' .. tostring(why or '')
end

steps.text: The test now holds camera.follow and goes back to the Arisen by passing his character. The camera must NOT glide or move: it stays where it is (with this claim a camera mod would place it). Only a glow plays.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac3 then G_ac3 = true
G_cl = _G.DPC_API.claim('camera.follow', { mod = 'api-control-1' })
local ok, why = _G.DPC_API.possess(_G.DPC_API.state().arisen.chara, { mod = 'api-control-1' })
G_res = tostring(ok) .. ' ' .. tostring(why or '')
end

steps.text: Claim given back. Main pawn again, then release_pawn: both with the normal transition, and the camera back behind the Arisen at the end.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac4 then G_ac4 = os.clock(); if G_cl then _G.DPC_API.release(G_cl); G_cl = nil end; _G.DPC_API.possess(0, { mod = 'api-control-1' }) end
if not G_ac4b and os.clock() - G_ac4 > 4.5 then G_ac4b = true; local ok, why = _G.DPC_API.release_pawn({ mod = 'api-control-1' }); G_res = tostring(ok) .. ' ' .. tostring(why or '') end

steps.text: Keyboard shortcuts are now OFF (for this session only). Press F6 once: NOTHING should happen. Then press End.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac5 then G_ac5 = true
G_ov = _G.DPC_API.override('hotkeys_on', false, { mod = 'api-control-1' })
end

steps.text: Keyboard shortcuts back ON. Press F6: you take control of the selected pawn. Press F6 again to go back to the Arisen, then End.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_ac6 then G_ac6 = true
if G_ov then _G.DPC_API.clear_override(G_ov); G_ov = nil end
end

steps.text: Optional look, change nothing: REFramework menu > DPC settings > Controls has 'Keyboard shortcuts on' at the top and a Clear button next to every key. Press End to finish.

probes.active: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; return d and d.state.active == true
probes.slot: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; return d and d.state.active and d.state.pawn_idx or -1
probes.cine: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; return d ~= nil and d.R.cine ~= nil
probes.who: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; if not d then return 'no DPC' end; return d.state.active and ('playing ' .. tostring(d.state.pawn_name)) or 'the Arisen'
probes.keys: local d = _G.DPC_dbg; return d and tostring(d.cfg.hotkeys_on)
